name: Steal An Egg
summary: Steal An Egg has no codes and no way to redeem them. Here's what that means, and where the first ones would show up.
about:
Steal An Egg is a Roblox collection game where you take eggs from nests around the map, hatch them into animals, and build up a collection that earns while you play. Other players can rob your animals, and you can rob theirs.

It's one of the biggest games on Roblox, with well over a million players online at once, which is why so many people search for codes that don't exist.
codesNote:
Steal An Egg has no codes, and that isn't a case of us failing to find any. The game has no code redemption box anywhere in it, so there's nothing to type a code into even if one existed.

The quickest way to tell whether any Roblox game has codes is to look for the redeem box. Steal An Egg doesn't have one, and the games it takes after have mostly skipped codes too, leaning on limited-time events instead.

That can change. Games add a redeem box once they want a way to hand out rewards, and this page will say so the same day it happens. Until then, ignore any video or site listing "working Steal An Egg codes", because they're guessing.

faq.q: Does Steal An Egg have codes?
faq.a: No. There are no codes, and the game doesn't have a redemption box either, so there's nowhere to enter one. Any list of working codes you find elsewhere is made up.

faq.q: How can I tell if a Roblox game has codes at all?
faq.a: Look for the redeem box, usually in the shop or settings menu. If a game has no box, it has no codes. Steal An Egg has no box.

faq.q: Where would the first codes appear?
faq.a: The game's Discord and its Roblox group are where developers announce things first. The Discord also lets you sign up for notifications, so you'd hear about a code there before any website posted it.

faq.q: Will Steal An Egg ever get codes?
faq.a: Nobody can say for certain. Games usually add a redeem box when they want a way to give rewards out, often after a quiet period or a big update. We watch the game's announcements and this page updates the same day anything changes.

faq.q: What can I do instead of waiting for codes?
faq.a: Keep your animals working while you play, since they earn while you're online, and put the coins straight back into hatching. Free gifts in the game are worth claiming as soon as they appear.

faq.q: How often do you check this?
faq.a: The game's Roblox page and announcements are watched automatically, and the date at the top of this page updates whenever we recheck.
